audit_moe_render_review.stdout:
usage: audit_moe_render_review.py [-h] --pack PACK [--composed COMPOSED]
                                  --review REVIEW
                                  [--runtime-store RUNTIME_STORE]
                                  [--runtime-receipt RUNTIME_RECEIPT]
                                  [--output OUTPUT]

Fail closed when a rendered moe candidate is not eligible for promotion. This
auditor validates recorded pixel-review evidence; it does not inspect or score
an image by itself. A technical PASS still cannot establish that the result
feels moe: representative promotion also requires the requesting user's
explicit acceptance.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pack PACK           Candidate-pack JSON path or inline JSON
  --composed COMPOSED   Audited composed-prompt JSON; required for typed v9
                        character response or when the pack exposes optional
                        visual concept candidates
  --review REVIEW       Render-review JSON path or inline JSON
  --runtime-store RUNTIME_STORE
  --runtime-receipt RUNTIME_RECEIPT
  --output OUTPUT       Optional path for the audit JSON

install_photo_h_f2_runtime.stdout:
usage: install_photo_h_f2_runtime.py [-h] --source-store SOURCE_STORE
                                     --generation-id GENERATION_ID

Install an already qualified H-F2 release without writing any CURRENT. All
candidate, code and embedding members are verified and independently copied.
The installed config selects the release for new managed CLI runs.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source-store SOURCE_STORE
  --generation-id GENERATION_ID
